findings.detail: The maturity date source cell is 02/24/2 8, i.e. 2028-02-24 after joining the split year, but the extracted maturity_date is 2002-02-24.

rationale: Class 1 single-cell maturity_date check. The flagged row stores maturity_date as 2002-02-24, making it appear before the 2024-12-31 report date. Raw SOI table 18 row 24 shows the same Hoffmaster Group Incremental Term Loan with the maturity cell rendered as 02/24/2 8, adjacent to the matching acquisition date, cost, and fair value. This is a formatting split of 02/24/28, not a 2002 maturity, so the stored maturity_date is a real extraction error.
